name: @kalo-ai/plugin-sdk
description: Typed SDK for building Kalo AI Agent plugins

scripts.prepack: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.publish:npm: if [ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ]; then npm publish --access public; else echo 'Interactive npm publish needs a TTY. Run: cd packages/plugin-sdk && npm publish --access public' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.publish:jsr: if [ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ]; then deno publish --config ./deno.json; else echo 'Interactive JSR publish needs a TTY. Run deno publish directly.' >&2; exit 1; fi
